import argparse
import json
import os

import torch
from datasets import Dataset
from peft import LoraConfig, TaskType
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, set_seed
from trl import SFTConfig, SFTTrainer


def load_data(data_dir: str, condition: str):
    """Load train and test JSONL files for a given condition."""
    def read_jsonl(path):
        data = []
        with open(path) as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    data.append(json.loads(line))
        return data

    train_path = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{condition}_train.jsonl")
    test_path = os.path.join(data_dir, f"{condition}_test.jsonl")
    return read_jsonl(train_path), read_jsonl(test_path)


def to_chat_text(items: list[dict], tokenizer) -> list[dict]:
    """Convert data items to chat-formatted text strings."""
    texts = []
    for item in items:
        messages = [
            {"role": "user", "content": item["input"]},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": item["output"]},
        ]
        text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False)
        texts.append({"text": text})
    return texts


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="LoRA SFT training for trace-verdict classification.")
    parser.add_argument("--condition", required=True, choices=["no_trace", "vota", "full_trace"],
                        help="Training condition: no_trace, vota, or full_trace")
    parser.add_argument("--data_dir", default="/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/",
                        help="Directory containing formatted training data")
    parser.add_argument("--model_path", default="/root/trace-verdict-study/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct",
                        help="Path to base model")
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", default=None,
                        help="Checkpoint output dir (default: /root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-checkpoints/{condition})")
    parser.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0, help="GPU device number")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed")
    parser.add_argument("--wandb_project", default="trace-verdict-study", help="W&B project name")
    parser.add_argument("--wandb_run_name", default=None,
                        help="W&B run name (default: {condition}_seed{seed})")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.output_dir is None:
        args.output_dir = f"/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-checkpoints/{args.condition}"
    if args.wandb_run_name is None:
        args.wandb_run_name = f"{args.condition}_seed{args.seed}"

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    set_seed(args.seed)

    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = str(args.gpu)
    os.environ["WANDB_PROJECT"] = args.wandb_project

    print(f"Condition: {args.condition}")
    print(f"Model: {args.model_path}")
    print(f"Output: {args.output_dir}")

    train_data, eval_data = load_data(args.data_dir, args.condition)
    print(f"Train: {len(train_data)}, Eval: {len(eval_data)}")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    train_dataset = Dataset.from_list(to_chat_text(train_data, tokenizer))
    eval_dataset = Dataset.from_list(to_chat_text(eval_data, tokenizer))

    print("Loading model...")
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model_path,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        trust_remote_code=True,
        device_map={"": 0},
    )

    lora_config = LoraConfig(
        r=16,
        lora_alpha=32,
        lora_dropout=0.05,
        target_modules=["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj", "gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj"],
        task_type=TaskType.CAUSAL_LM,
    )

    training_args = SFTConfig(
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        num_train_epochs=3,
        per_device_train_batch_size=4,
        per_device_eval_batch_size=4,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=8,
        learning_rate=2e-4,
        warmup_ratio=0.1,
        weight_decay=0.01,
        bf16=True,
        max_length=2048,
        logging_steps=10,
        eval_strategy="epoch",
        save_strategy="epoch",
        report_to="wandb" if os.environ.get("WANDB_API_KEY") else "tensorboard",
        run_name=args.wandb_run_name,
        seed=args.seed,
        dataset_text_field="text",
    )

    trainer = SFTTrainer(
        model=model,
        args=training_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
        peft_config=lora_config,
        processing_class=tokenizer,
    )

    print("Starting training...")
    trainer.train()

    final_dir = os.path.join(args.output_dir, "final")
    trainer.save_model(final_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(final_dir)
    print(f"Training complete. Model saved to {final_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
